newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains volatile in limited volume.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains volatile in limited volume.

text.p: UK physical grains prices were volatile on Wednesday as the market reacted and over-reacted to sterling's moves, traders said.
But price moves were more than was justified by sterling's progress against other European currencies, traders said.
One trader reckoned the grains market had over-anticipated sterling moves.

Another felt strongly that current prices were not enough to make supplies available. "At these levels you can't get any physical supply in the market," he said. "There are plenty of buyers around. It's got to go up. Not by much - but it has got to go up," he said.

Among the delivered market trades reported by brokers were milling wheat at 111 stg for June delivery, with feed wheat done at between 88.00 and 89.00 stg for June delivery to Norfolk/Suffolk. Barley was traded at 91.50 for June delivery to Yorkshire.
